kapp_prediction.note: flux-derived kapp predicts measured kcat within experimental noise for FLUXED enzymes (Davidi&Milo 2016) — but idle enzymes and the far-below-saturation tail escape it

verdict: VERIFIED: 100% of measured kcats obey the constraint the check relies on (0 impossible), and enzymes run at a median 40% of their measured max — matching the known in-vivo saturation (~50%, Davidi & Milo). The flag is grounded in measurement, not circular. Caveat: the overlap of measured-kcat AND operating-rate is small (n=46); the constraint is verified where we can, and no measured kcat contradicts it.
